about: Temporal backend against a real dev server: two invocations submitted into the session's store run on a worker that is SIGKILLed mid-activity. The idempotent one retries on a new worker under the same key and succeeds; the at_most_once one ends UNKNOWN and is never resent. Each outcome lands in the store and wakes the session.

turns.text: Nothing to do until the host's invocations finish.
